resources.string: From a file on this phone (SSH config or CSV)

Termius has no export of its own, so TermiNow can not read its data directly. What works:

• An SSH config file your Termius hosts came from, like ~/.ssh/config of a computer.
• A CSV with the columns of the Termius CSV import (Groups, Label, Tags, Hostname, Protocol, Port, Username, Password), which some tools export.

Keys are imported separately in Keychain → + → Import SSH key from file. Passwords in a CSV are encrypted on this phone when they are saved; delete the CSV afterwards.
